definitions.full: H8395. tebusah [ תְּבוּסָה ] noun feminine down-treading = ruin, downfall, construct אחזיהו תְּבוּסַת 2Chr 22:7 the downfall of Ahaziah . בוע (assumed as √ of following, compare Lag BN 10 ; but √ perhaps בעע ; according to Sta § 257 a quadriliteral Arabic , efferbuit et commotus fuit (sanguis), puteus cujus aqua haurienti propinqua ).
